description: Dept. of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers Month of April
reasoning: This gazette notification announces special allowance payments for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper growing/manufacturing trade based on cost of living index calculations. This falls under public sector service administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions administered through the Department of Labour, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government structure/personnel matter or other specialized category.
